why_not: I only hire people another local owner has vouched for, and nobody I know has used him. He's a stranger working from Kuwait with no UK clients and demo sites for made-up businesses, so it reads like the other cold DMs I've had this month.

I check Google and Trustpilot before I contact anyone, and there's nothing to check here: no UK clients, no reviews, and the one real project is anonymous and in Kuwait. Pay-when-happy is nice, but I'd still be giving up hours to calls, scoping and two rounds of changes with someone I can't vet.

My Fresha page and Instagram already get people booked in, and I can tweak the Wix page myself at midnight when I'm done for the day. Pay-when-happy is a nice touch, but I don't see what a new site does that I haven't already got.

My Fresha page takes the bookings and Instagram brings people in, so I honestly don't see what a £655 site does for me that I haven't already got for free. The pay-when-happy thing is nice, but it doesn't fix the fact that I don't feel I need it.

When I need a website I ring three local firms, get three quotes and go with the middle one. A lone freelancer in Kuwait with no UK clients or reviews wouldn't make my shortlist, even with pay-when-happy.

I always get three local quotes and go with the middle one. At £655 from someone in Kuwait with no UK reviews, he'd be the cheapest quote by a mile, and I never go with the cheapest. Pay-when-happy is nice but it doesn't make me trust him.

I already pay next to nothing for my Wix page and my Fresha booking link, and people find me fine through those and the Facebook group. £655 plus £43 a month is real money for me when what I've got already does the job well enough.
